description.p: Electrum is a lightweight Bitcoin wallet focused on speed, with low resource usage and simplifying Bitcoin. Startup times are instant because it operates in conjunction with high-performance servers that handle the most complicated parts of the Bitcoin system.

ul.li: security: fix CVE-2012-2459 in SPV verification — reject left-sibling duplicates (#10568)
new: support LNURL LUD-17 payment identifiers (#10575)
new: detect when opening a wallet file created on a different chain (#10592)
changed: remove support for BIP-70 payment identifiers (#10535)
changed: refuse to pay LNURL-pay identifiers if a 'successAction' field is present (#10712)
fix: update CoinGecko exchange rate provider; remove broken CoinDesk provider (#10572, #10720)
lightning: lazy trampoline forwarding without network graph (#10544); require anchor outputs for new channels (#10622)
lightning: towards bolt12 — add merkle tree signing scheme (#10597)
hardware wallets: new Trezor Safe 7 support (#10677); Ledger legacy bitcoin app compatibility fix (#10603)
QML/Android: support renaming wallets (#10573); minimum Android raised to 8.0
security: External Plugin authorization bypass — local code execution (GHSA-vw94-r84p-66qf)
security: Nostr Wallet Connect plugin daily spending limit bypass (GHSA-q7m2-785w-r585)
changed: set restrictive unix umask (0077) application-wide by default (#10547)
fix: failing assert for wallets with old unpaid LN payment requests (#10502)
Qt GUI: move LN fee slider to payment dialog (#10516)
submarine swaps: fix Swap Providers window losing track of providers; fix percentage rounding errors (#10528)
daemon: forbid setconfig to change rpcserver settings in-flight; GUI mode starts only limited RPC server (#10534, #10548)
timelock_recovery plugin: fix checksum calculation per BIP-0128 (#10524)
new: changelog website accessible from Help toolbar menu (#10433)
new: show translation completion percentage in language names (#10479)
new: allow changing font size in console (#10494)
changed: validate Electrum server address input with UI feedback (#10441)
fix: broken addresses tab for imported watch-only wallets (#10436)
fix: improved fee estimation for replacement transactions (#10453)
fix: handle wallet DB upgrade failure for users with pending Lightning HTLCs (#10489)
hardware wallets: new Ledger Nano Gen 5 support (#10457)
lightning: improved safety when revealing preimage on-chain; gossip fixes (#10442, #10448, #10493)
translations: call for proofreaders after malicious string injections found in electrum-locale repo
new: Submarine Payments — reverse swaps to external address, onchain payments from lightning balance (#10303)
new: support LNURL-withdraw / LUD-03 (#9993)
new: Electrum Protocol version 1.6 support (#10295)
new: QML/Android — manual fee editing, biometric authentication (#10340, #10371)
new: CLI export_lightning_preimage command (#10242)
changed: non-SPV verified transactions now considered unconfirmed (#10216)
changed: always enforce dnssec validation for Openalias (#10349)
removed: payserver plugin, now external at spesmilo/electrum-payserver (d36b753)
Android: support 16kb page size; bump target SDK to 35; OpenSSL 3.0.18; Python 3.11.14
AppImage: migrate build to use modern/maintained appimagetool (#10019)
changed: minrelayfee clamps from [1, 50] to [0.1, 50] sat/vbyte (#10096)
new: add support for "mutinynet" signet test network (#10134)
new: network won't request same tx from server that we just broadcast (#10111)
new: logging config LOGS_MAX_TOTAL_SIZE_BYTES to limit log size on disk (#10159)
fix: cannot open keystore-encryption-only wallets on Android (#10171)
lightning: slow down peers sending too much gossip and other rate-limits (#10153)
CLI: reverse_swap new mandatory 'prepayment' parameter; new get_submarine_swap_providers command (#10158, #10165)
fix: QR scanner crashes on Android due to null/orphaned View (#10071)
fix: creating a tx with a pre-segwit watchonly wallet (#10042)
fix: several bugs in new hold_invoice APIs; minor breaking changes (#10059, #10082)
new: lnpay command accepts max_cltv, max_fee_msat parameters (#10067)
hardware wallets: bitbox02 bumped to 7.0.0 — adds BitBox02 "Nova" support (#10040)
reworked crash reporter — always shown on uncaught exceptions (#10052)
new: parallelize block-header-chunks downloads (#10033)
Terms of Use screen added to the install wizard
Nostr support via new dependency electrum-aionostr; submarine swaps over Nostr — anyone can run a swap server
Third-party plugins: install plugins distributed as ZIP files on desktop binaries, gated by a plugin authorization password
Lightning: anchor channels by default (#9264); support for onion messages (#9039)
Qt Desktop GUI: migrated from Qt5 to Qt6 (#9189); screenshot "protection" on Windows (#9898)
Wallet unlocking: password kept in memory so signing transactions doesn't require re-entering password
Transaction batching: drop-down menu proposes batching new payment into existing mempool txns
Keystore enabling/disabling: add a seed to existing watching-only wallet or pair with hardware device
Lightning address contacts; accounting addresses for force-closure transactions rendered in orange
New plugins: Nostr Wallet Connect (NIP-47), Nostr Cosigner (replaces Cosigner pool), Timelock Recovery
CLI: improved help; hold invoices; new commands (listconfig, onchain_capital_gains, hold_invoice commands)
Hardware wallets: Coldcard multisig config upload via USB; KeepKey vendored fork; Ledger HW.1/Nano support removed
Min OS: Windows 10 (1809) x86_64; macOS 11; Linux AppImage x86_64 glibc 2.31
Min Python 3.10; new first-party deps electrum-aionostr and electrum-ecc
fix: regression: bump_fee and dscancel dialogs erroring (#9273)
fix: failing WalletDB upgrade(58) in 4.5.3 (#8913), for wallets with partial txs saved into the history as local txs
changed: use longer final_cltv_delta for client-normal-swap, to give more time for user to come back online while doing the swap (#8940)
changed: create trampoline onions even when directly paying a trampoline forwarder node (777c2ffb)
fix: allow adding SLIP-19 ownership proofs to complete inputs (#8910)
fix: a race in swapserver when handling server-normal-swaps (#8825)
fix: MPP regression when using gossip that made paying small invoices fail (95c55c542)
fix: better handle dataloss (#8814)
also support unfinished wallets when opened through File>Open (#8809)
fix crash when LNURLp is scanned/pasted (#8822)
fix crash for new wallets having cosigner using hww #8808)
fix crash in finalizer when txid is undefined (#8807)
various UI fixes (291f0ce, 3d9996a, ec81f00)
security fix: multiple lightning-related security issues have been fixed.
fix lnurl-pay when config.BTC_AMOUNTS_ADD_THOUSANDS_SEP is True(5b4df759)
fix: we would sometimes attempt sending MPP even if not supported by the invoice (2cf6173c)
Trezor: support longer than 9 character PIN codes (#8526)
Jade: support more custom-built DIY Jade devices (#8546)
fix regression in sign_transaction (#8463)
fix "rebalance_channels" function (#8468)
enforce that we run with python asserts enabled,regardless of platform
fix creating multisig wallets involving BIP39 seeds (#8432)
fix "cannot scroll to open a lightning channel" (#8446)
wizard: "confirm seed" screen to normalize whitespaces (#8442)
fix assert on address details screen (#8420)
better handle some expected errors in SwapDialog (#8430)
libsecp256k1: bump bundled version to 0.3.2 (10574bb1)
When creating new requests, reuse addresses of expired requests (fixes #7927).
Index requests by ID instead of receiving address. This affects the following commands: get_request, get_invoice, list_requests, list_invoices, delete_request, delete_invoice
Trampoline routing: remember routes that have failed. Try other routes instead of systematically raising tampoline fees.
Fix sweep to_local output from channel backup (#7959)
Harden build script for macOS binary: avoid using precompiled wheels from PyPI for most packages (#7918)
The Windows/AppImage/Android binaries are now built on debian using the snapshot.debian.org archive instead of ubuntu. This should help with historical reproducibility. (#7926)
PSBT: fix regression in 4.0.3 where UTXO data was not included in QR codes (#6600)
new feature: "Cancel tx" (#6641). The Qt/kivy GUI allows cancelling an unconfirmed RBF tx by double-spending its inputs to self.
Ledger: fix "The derivation path is unusual" warnings (#6512)
A few other minor bugfixes and usability improvements.
Lightning Network support (experimental)
Partially Signed Bitcoin Transactions (PSBT, BIP-174)
BitBox02, Multisign for Coldcard and latest Trezor fw support
Lots and lots of other minor bugfixes and improvements

description.p: Electrum 3.3.8 is here with another round of fixes:

ul.li: Fix some bugs with recent bump fee (RBF) improvements (#5483, #5502)
Fix #5491: watch-only wallets could not bump fee in some cases
Appimage: URLs could not be opened on some desktop environments (#5425)
Faster tx signing for segwit inputs for really large txns (#5494)
A few other minor bugfixes and usability improvements
